conventions.hover_D: claw raised D mm from the pose where the CLOSED jaw tips touch the floor (floor y = 581.034 - D); the same claw frame is used for open jaws, whose lowest point is 48.8 mm higher than the closed tips
conventions.grasp_zone: x (-40.0, 40.0), z (-13.0, 7.0) mm relative to the tube axis
conventions.ring_b: 0 < Euclidean distance to the grasp rectangle <= 100 mm
conventions.visible: floor sample lies inside the chosen FOV model AND its ray from the lens is not blocked by any claw solid
